item.title: EU AI Act Compliance for Developers: August 2026 Deadline Guide
item.description: The EU AI Act imposes legally binding obligations on developers and deployers of AI systems in the EU, with the primary enforcement deadline of August 2, 2026. However, the AI Omnibus deal reached in May 2026 significantly changed which requirements apply on that date — extending certain Annex III high-risk AI system deadlines to December 2027. This guide tells you exactly what still hits in August 2026, what got delayed, and the specific technical steps engineering teams must take now.
